batches.title: Batch-Roasted Chicken Breast & Quinoa for Mediterranean Bowls (Mon–Tue lunches)
steps: 1. Preheat oven to 200°C (fan 180°C).
2. Rinse 400g dry quinoa under cold water using a fine-mesh sieve for 1 minute.
3. Bring 800ml lightly salted water to a boil in a medium saucepan; add quinoa, reduce to a simmer, cover and cook 12–14 minutes until water is absorbed and the little white tails have sprouted.
4. Fluff with a fork; spread on a large plate or tray to cool, then transfer to a sealed container. Label: 'Quinoa – Mon/Tue lunches'. Refrigerate up to 4 days.
5. Meanwhile, lay 700g chicken breast on a lined baking tray; drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil.
6. Season all over with 1 tsp dried oregano, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp salt, 1/2 tsp black pepper.
7. Bake 20–22 minutes until internal temperature reads 75°C or juices run clear.
8. Allow to cool 10 minutes, then slice into thick pieces. Transfer to a sealed container. Label: 'Chicken – Mon/Tue lunches'. Refrigerate up to 3 days.
9. Cube 2 courgettes and 3 red peppers into 2cm pieces; toss with 1 tbsp olive oil, salt and pepper on a separate baking tray.
10. Roast at 200°C for 22–25 minutes, turning once halfway, until lightly charred. Cool and refrigerate in a sealed container. Label: 'Roasted veg – Mon/Tue lunches'.
yields: ~550 g roasted courgette and red pepper

day_of_assembly.Monday: Portion quinoa 200g Diego / 140g Diana + chicken 150g/110g + roasted veg 120g/90g into bowls; microwave 2 min; add fresh cherry tomatoes and olive oil.
day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Same as Monday. Use remaining chicken, quinoa and roasted veg from container.

storage.safety_note: Cool quickly; never leave poultry at room temp > 2 h. Reheat to 74 °C through.

batches.title: Green Lentil & Vegetable Stew (Mon dinner + Wed lunch)
steps: 1. Rinse 300g dry green lentils thoroughly under cold water.
2. Dice 2 medium carrots and 2 celery sticks (céleri branche) into small cubes.
3. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat; add carrots and celery; sauté 4–5 minutes until slightly softened.
4. Add 3 crushed garlic cloves; cook 1 minute more.
5. Add lentils, 1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes, 1 litre of vegetable stock (made from cubes), 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tsp smoked paprika, salt and pepper.
6. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low; simmer uncovered 25–30 minutes until lentils are tender but not mushy.
7. Taste and adjust seasoning. Remove from heat; cool to room temperature.
8. Transfer to a sealed container. Label: 'Lentil stew – Mon dinner / Wed lunch'. Refrigerate up to 4 days.
yields: ~1.5 kg cooked lentil and vegetable stew (approximately 6–8 portions)

day_of_assembly.Monday: Portion into saucepan (Diego 300g, Diana 220g); add spinach 80g total; heat 4 min; serve with pan-seared salmon.
day_of_assembly.Wednesday: Reheat portioned stew (Diego 320g, Diana 240g) with extra spinach 100g total until wilted; serve with 1 slice wholegrain bread each.

storage.safety_note: Cooked beans and lentils keep well. Freeze in portions for quick meals.

batches.title: Batch Brown Rice (Tue/Thu/Fri lunches + Tue/Wed dinners)
steps: 1. Rinse 700g dry brown rice under cold running water for 1 minute.
2. Add to a large saucepan with 1.5 litres lightly salted water.
3. Bring to a boil over high heat; stir once, then reduce to the lowest heat setting.
4. Cover tightly and cook 28–30 minutes without lifting the lid.
5. After 30 minutes, check: grains should be tender and water absorbed. If not, cover and cook 5 more minutes.
6. Remove from heat; let steam covered for 5 minutes, then fluff with a fork.
7. Spread on a tray to cool quickly (30 min at room temperature).
8. Divide into two labelled containers: 'Brown rice – Tue/Wed dinners' and 'Brown rice – Thu/Fri lunches'. Refrigerate up to 4 days.
Note: Also used for marinated tofu (see prep_batch_5 for the tofu-stir-fry component).

day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Microwave brown rice: Diego 220g, Diana 160g for 2 min; serve under tofu stir-fry.
day_of_assembly.Wednesday: Microwave brown rice: Diego 200g, Diana 150g for 2 min; use for Mexican turkey-bean bowl.
day_of_assembly.Thursday: Microwave brown rice: Diego 200g, Diana 150g for 2 min; serve under leftover tofu stir-fry.
day_of_assembly.Friday: Microwave brown rice: Diego 180g, Diana 130g for 2 min; use for Mexican leftover bowl.

storage.safety_note: ⚠ HIGH RISK: Bacillus cereus spores survive cooking. Cool rice within 1 h, refrigerate, use within 1 day. Never reheat more than once.

batches.title: Ratatouille Base (Thu dinner + Fri dinner)
steps: 1. Dice 1 large aubergine, 2 courgettes, and 2 ripe tomatoes into 2cm cubes.
2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large heavy-bottomed pan or Dutch oven over medium heat.
3. Add aubergine cubes; cook 5 minutes, stirring, until they start to soften and absorb the oil.
4. Add courgette cubes; cook 4 more minutes.
5. Add 2 crushed garlic cloves and 1 can (400g) chopped tomatoes; stir well.
6. Season with 2 tsp herbes de Provence, 1/2 tsp sugar (to balance acidity), salt and pepper.
7. Simmer on low heat, partially covered, for 20 minutes, stirring occasionally, until vegetables are very tender.
8. Taste and adjust seasoning; add a drizzle of olive oil for richness.
9. Cool to room temperature; transfer to a sealed container. Label: 'Ratatouille – Thu/Fri'. Refrigerate up to 4 days.

day_of_assembly.Thursday: Spoon ratatouille around cod fillets in baking dish (Diego 200g, Diana 160g); bake together 18–20 min at 200°C.
day_of_assembly.Friday: Warm 270g ratatouille total in a small pan; use as omelette filling (Diego 150g, Diana 120g).

storage.safety_note: Cooked vegetables store well. Roasted veg can be eaten cold in salads.

batches.title: Marinated Tofu for Asian Stir-Fry (Tue dinner + Thu lunch)
steps: 1. Remove 600g firm tofu from packaging; wrap in 3 layers of kitchen paper.
2. Place on a plate and put a heavy pan or book on top; press for 15 minutes to drain excess water.
3. Cut pressed tofu into 2cm cubes.
4. In a bowl, mix marinade: 3 tbsp soy sauce, 2 tsp sesame oil, 1 tsp garlic powder, 1 tsp smoked paprika.
5. Add tofu cubes; toss gently to coat each piece. Do not break the cubes.
6. Cover bowl with cling film or transfer to a sealed container.
7. Label: 'Marinated tofu – Tue dinner / Thu lunch'. Refrigerate overnight or up to 24 hours.

day_of_assembly.Tuesday: Stir-fry marinated tofu in sesame oil 5–6 min until golden; combine with stir-fried broccoli, red pepper, snap peas; toss with extra soy sauce, oyster sauce, fresh ginger.
day_of_assembly.Thursday: Reheat leftover tofu stir-fry (Diego 250g, Diana 190g) in microwave 2 min with brown rice.

storage.safety_note: Cool within 2 h of cooking, refrigerate, use within 3 days, reheat to 74 °C.
